operations.name: Saw Cut Stock
operations.setup_note: Cut hot-rolled round bar to blank length with facing allowance at both ends; stock diameter is within the saw limit.

operations.name: CNC Lathe – Rough Turn
operations.setup_note: Chuck the saw-cut blank in soft jaws and face one end to establish the axial reference. Turn the larger OD features before roughing the bores; the blank diameter is within the lathe chuck limit.

operations.name: CNC Lathe – Finish Turn
operations.setup_note: Reverse the part and locate on the rough-turned cylindrical surface in soft jaws; face to final length. Finish both bores before the thin-wall ODs, using the established coaxial datum.

operations.name: Deburr
operations.setup_note: Support the turned component without distorting its thin wall; break remaining sharp edges after machining and before coating.

operations.name: Clean and Degrease
operations.setup_note: Clean and degrease the fully machined, deburred parts before phosphate treatment; process the order as one batch if the cleaning capacity permits.

operations.name: Mask for Phosphate Treatment
operations.setup_note: Mask the precision cylindrical surfaces as required by the confirmed PS-119.0 coverage requirements; handle parts to keep cleaned surfaces free of contamination.

operations.name: Phosphate Coat
operations.setup_note: Apply phosphate per PS-119.0 after all machining; batch the 10 parts together if the treatment line's rack capacity permits.

operations.name: Remove Masking
operations.setup_note: Remove masking after treatment and verify the protected surfaces are clean and free of coating intrusion.

operations.name: Final Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect the finished dimensions and phosphate coverage after treatment; verify critical diameters against the drawing and confirmed coating requirements.

clarifications.question: What is the specified diameter and tolerance for through bore F05? The routing view currently assigns it the same assumed diameter as the F04 OD.
clarifications.suggested_default: Hold machining of F05 and treat its extracted Ø153.885 mm dimension as provisional until the drawing callout is confirmed.

clarifications.question: Which of the machined surfaces F01, F02, F04, and F05 must receive phosphate, and which must be masked?
clarifications.suggested_default: Mask the precision cylindrical surfaces and phosphate only the surfaces designated for treatment by PS-119.0.

clarifications.question: What phosphate coating thickness or dimensional allowance does PS-119.0 require on the tolerance-controlled diameters?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the PS-119.0 specified coating thickness and compensate machined dimensions only where that specification requires it.

assumptions.text: Because the blank type is unstated and no qualifying tube or bright-bar condition is given, use hot-rolled round bar rather than seamless tube.
Size the bar at 170.1 mm diameter and 111.93 mm length, using 5 mm over the maximum OD and 8 mm over finished length for machining allowance.
F05 is routed provisionally using its extracted assumed dimensions; its apparent equality to the F04 OD must be resolved before machining.
Use the in-house plating_line for phosphate treatment based on its listed coating capability; confirm that it supports the specific PS-119.0 requirements.
Omit center drilling because the part's length-to-diameter ratio is below 4:1 and the blank can be held in the chuck; the route does not include between-centers work.

Omit threading, grooving, and part-off steps because no such features are present and each part is cut to blank length on the saw. Omit a separate cure/bake because the callout is a phosphate conversion coating and no cure or hydrogen-relief bake requirement is provided; routine drying is assumed part of treatment.
